why: The English cover headline wraps badly, splitting the score across two lines as 'INDIA LOOK TO GO 2-' / '0 UP IN WELLINGTON'. The story is also a pre-match preview, written at 7:20 am IST and still saying the toss 'was scheduled for 7:00 am' with no toss result. First ball was at 7:30 am, so by publish it previews a match that is already being played. frontpages.txt asks for the result or live score.
